== Published English Original Virtual Set 3 wording ==
The old Shield suspends I Did It! on a tie or when you occupy more battlegrounds. The later one requires you to occupy more. The older text excludes this Shield from the limit when played from Fear Is My Ally, while the later text changes the number on Fear Is My Ally. Both preserve the opponent’s protected Boonta Eve Podrace retrieval.
